description: Execute a WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility remediation sweep across a web application with 200 screens/pages. The remediation must follow: audit all screens (automated scan with axe-core + manual audit), catalog violations by severity (critical: no keyboard trap; serious: missing ARIA; moderate: color contrast; minor: heading order), fix violations in component waves (wave 1: critical, wave 2: serious, wave 3: moderate, wave 4: minor), per-screen verification (re-run axe-core + manual check after each wave), and a final re-audit (full sweep to verify all violations are resolved). A rollback plan must exist per wave (revert component changes if they break functionality). Risk factors: ARIA changes can break screen reader behavior, keyboard navigation changes can affect power users, and some fixes require design changes (not just code). Tools available: axe-core, Lighthouse, NVDA, VoiceOver, browser DevTools, React/Angular component library.
